SELECT SUM(total_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS average_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries

WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
)
SELECT
  batter,
  ROUND(100.0 * boundary_runs / total_runs, 2) AS boundary_percentage
FROM batter_stats
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT d.batter
  FROM deliveries AS d
  JOIN matches AS m ON d.match_id = m.id
  GROUP BY d.batter
  HAVING SUM(d.batsman_runs) >= 1000
)

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS ball_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL
   OR LOWER(extras_type) NOT IN ('wides', 'wide', 'noballs', 'no-ball', 'no balls')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  batter,
  SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM matches AS m
JOIN (
  SELECT match_id, batting_team
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1
  GROUP BY match_id, batting_team
) AS first_innings
  ON m.id = first_innings.match_id
WHERE m.winner IS NOT NULL
  AND m.winner <> first_innings.batting_team
GROUP BY m.winner
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(total_runs) AS total_powerplay_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 0 AND 5

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(extras_type, '')) NOT IN ('wide', 'wides') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
)
SELECT
  batter,
  runs * 100.0 / legal_balls AS strike_rate
FROM batter_stats
WHERE runs >= 300
  AND legal_balls > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(extras_type, '')) NOT IN ('wide', 'wides', 'noball', 'noballs', 'no-ball', 'no-balls')
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS legal_balls,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(extras_type, '')) IN ('byes', 'legbyes', 'penalty')
        THEN batsman_runs
        ELSE total_runs
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  ROUND(runs_conceded * 6.0 / legal_balls, 2) AS economy
FROM bowling_stats
WHERE legal_balls >= 1000
ORDER BY runs_conceded * 6.0 / legal_balls ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      batsman_runs +
      CASE
        WHEN extras_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN extra_runs
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN is_wicket = 1
         AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS wickets
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  ROUND(1.0 * runs_conceded / wickets, 2) AS bowling_average
FROM bowling_stats
WHERE wickets >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH team_runs AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    d.batting_team AS team,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
  FROM matches AS m
  JOIN deliveries AS d
    ON m.id = d.match_id
  GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    team,
    runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY season
      ORDER BY runs DESC, team
    ) AS rn
  FROM team_runs
)
SELECT season, team, runs
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season

SELECT
  batter,
  CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS average_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) >= 30
ORDER BY average_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.winner AS winning_team,
       SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
FROM matches AS m
JOIN deliveries AS d
  ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE d.inning = 2
  AND m.winner = d.batting_team
GROUP BY m.id, m.winner
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  bowler,
  COUNT(*) AS wicket_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN (
    'run out',
    'retired hurt',
    'retired out',
    'obstructing the field'
  )
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wicket_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
FROM deliveries
WHERE batter NOT IN (
  SELECT player_dismissed
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN toss_decision = 'field' AND winner = toss_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM matches

WITH team_matches AS (
  SELECT team1 AS team, winner
  FROM matches
  WHERE season = '2023'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT team2 AS team, winner
  FROM matches
  WHERE season = '2023'
),
team_stats AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
  FROM team_matches
  GROUP BY team
)
SELECT
  team,
  ROUND(100.0 * wins / matches_played, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM team_stats
WHERE matches_played >= 5
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  bowler,
  player_dismissed AS batter,
  COUNT(*) AS dismissal_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'hit wicket')
GROUP BY bowler, player_dismissed
ORDER BY dismissal_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(first_innings_total)
FROM (
  SELECT d.match_id, SUM(d.total_runs) AS first_innings_total
  FROM deliveries AS d
  JOIN matches AS m ON m.id = d.match_id
  WHERE d.inning = 1
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM deliveries AS d2
      WHERE d2.match_id = m.id
        AND d2.inning = 2
        AND d2.batting_team = m.winner
    )
  GROUP BY d.match_id
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) FROM deliveries

SELECT 
    batter,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_runs)) AS boundary_percentage
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT batter FROM deliveries GROUP BY batter HAVING sum(batsman_runs) >= 1000)
SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS ball_count FROM deliveries WHERE extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') OR extras_type IS NULL GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY ball_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM matches m
JOIN (
    SELECT match_id, batting_team AS team1_batting
    FROM deliveries
    WHERE inning = 1
    GROUP BY match_id
) d ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE m.winner IS NOT NULL 
  AND m.winner != '' 
  AND m.winner != 'No Result' 
  AND m.winner != 'Tie'
  AND m.winner != d.team1_batting
GROUP BY m.winner
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT sum(total_runs) FROM deliveries WHERE "over" BETWEEN 0 AND 5

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    batter,
    (SUM(batsman_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type = 'wides' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)) AS strike_rate
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 300
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler, 
    SUM(total_runs - COALESCE(extra_runs, 0)) * 6.0 / COUNT(*) AS economy
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler, 
    CAST(SUM(total_runs - COALESCE(extra_runs, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_wicket = 1 AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bowling_average
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_wicket = 1 AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH team_season_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        d.batting_team AS team,
        SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
    GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        team,
        runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY runs DESC) as rn
    FROM team_season_runs
)
SELECT season, team, runs
FROM ranked_teams
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season

SELECT batter, CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS avg_runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.winner, SUM(d.total_runs) AS total_runs
FROM matches m
JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE m.result = 'wickets' AND d.inning = 2
GROUP BY m.id
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wicket_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wicket_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
FROM deliveries
WHERE batter NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_dismissed 
    FROM deliveries 
    WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN toss_winner = winner AND toss_decision = 'field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100) / COUNT(*) 
FROM matches

SELECT 
    team, 
    (CAST(wins AS REAL) / total_matches) * 100 AS win_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        t.team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner = t.team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
        COUNT(*) AS total_matches
    FROM matches m
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT team1 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
        UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT team2 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
    ) t ON t.team = m.team1 OR t.team = m.team2
    WHERE m.season = '2023'
    GROUP BY t.team
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, player_dismissed AS batter, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1 
  AND player_dismissed IS NOT NULL 
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler, player_dismissed
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT avg(first_innings_total) FROM (
  SELECT m.id, sum(d.total_runs) AS first_innings_total
  FROM matches m
  JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
  WHERE m.winner = m.team2 AND d.inning = 1
  GROUP BY m.id
)
